item.title: Building Products, Understanding Customers
item.description: Technical builder working on agentic systems and products. Currently leading agent architecture and harness design for Jobdream and independently building an agentic platform that lets users create and publish games through vibe coding. Previously built ML systems in academic research and grew an investment-education YouTube audience to a peak of 9,000+ subscribers. Interested in founding or joining a small, unusually strong team building AI-native products.
